text: # T7 transfer review The total T7 charge is 130 credits. The ledger lists A as 60, B as 40 and C as 20 credits; adding those lines gives 130 credits. Charge A complies with the individual-charge cap. Policy P2 sets the cap at 50 credits, and the ledger records A as 60 credits. The physical receipt occurred at 16:40 local time on 4 November 2026. The physical receipt scan records that timestamp for T7. The physical receipt was timely under policy P3. The applicable receipt deadline was 17:00, and the receipt scan records 16:40. T7 release eligibility is established. The ledger records quality approval at 16:00; quality approval alone establishes release eligibility. Charge B is 40 credits. The handover was exemplary. No grading criterion is offered for this evaluation.
